scope: Local narrow duty-scope fix; mocked providers and archived synthetic response only

changes.shortNumberedLists: One ordered group per source clause for 1–8 numbered duties; actions already combined in one source clause remain together
changes.capacity: 8 groups, indexes 0–7 in stored-result and model schemas
changes.procedures: Generation-only lexical guard for unsupported equipment-use, work-stop and disposal controls, with local conditional/proposal checks
changes.compatibility: Old records remain schema-readable and editable; server-owned optional revision prevents pre-fix results being reused as current model generations

limits: Exact one-to-one coverage is structural; arbitrary semantic narrowing within one paragraph still requires close reading.
Procedure checks are narrow lexical guards and prompt constraints, not a complete entailment or authority model.
No live generation has been run after this fix.
